verified_cpu_reconstruction_baseline.method: OpenCV SIFT + essential-matrix pose recovery + triangulation + voxel merge
verified_cpu_reconstruction_baseline.instruction: Reproduce or improve this method in sandbox; BLOCKED_RECON_ENGINE is not valid for classical SfM. Neural dense reconstruction may remain blocked.

pipeline: Use ONLY frames from the primary outdoor video for near-field reconstruction unless a candidate image is visually classified OUTDOOR first.
Extract 3-5 fps sharp video frames. Maintain exact frame timestamps.
Estimate camera poses with SIFT/ORB correspondences + essential matrix/RANSAC. Use optical-flow tracks to densify correspondences where stable.
Triangulate a colored source-derived point cloud. Reject non-positive depth, high reprojection error, floaters, and unstable pairs.
Register reconstructed camera trajectory and point cloud to the existing WP/path and canonical plan/GML using similarity transform. Do not invent GPS from frames.
Render source-derived geometry as true world-space colored splats/points, not image planes. Use circular/gaussian point sprites only; no rectangular photo cards.
Use plan/GML to render clean house shell geometry at the six canonical positions. House proportions/roof/wall forms must follow plans and day-walk visual evidence. Do not call them tents.
Derive house wall/roof material colors and repeating surface textures from OUTDOOR day-walk crops only. Never project whole photographs onto shells.
Build the path, stone border and terrace geometry from plan/path constraints and day-walk visual evidence. Extract tileable path/stone materials from outdoor frames.

Vegetation near the flight corridor should be represented first by source-derived point/splat geometry. Add modeled trunks/canopies only where their location is supported by reconstructed points/video evidence; no generic forest wall in foreground.
Keep satellite texture only outside the reconstructed local envelope as distant ground context.
camera: Reuse the smoothed arc-length local route.
Heading follows path tangent, roll=0, 6-8m look-ahead.
Use reconstructed video camera path only as visual alignment evidence, not as the final guest camera path.
Raw local clearance remains 3.5-4.0m against canonical/local terrain.

must_show: at least one correctly positioned modeled AUMARA house with outdoor-derived materials
real vegetation context from source points

pass_bar: owner can visually recognize the day-walk location
house reads as spatial geometry rather than a flat image
path and trees retain source-derived visual evidence
neural_upgrade_later: If/when GPU compute is available, MASt3R/DUSt3R/3DGS may replace/densify the source-derived splat layer without changing georef/house/path truth.
return: absolute /v3-3-proof URL + frame count + matched pairs + reconstructed point count + registration residual + short truth manifest
